# CareerReturns

> CareerReturns builds interactive, DCF-based financial calculators and data-backed guides that answer one question precisely: is this career or education investment worth it, in dollars, for a specific person's numbers? Every figure is modeled with NPV/IRR/break-even math, not opinion. Primary audience: MBA applicants and admits, career-break returners, and professionals evaluating pay, offers, and re-entry to work.

## Flagship report

- [MBA ROI Report 2026](https://careerreturns.com/mba-roi-report-2026): Original aggregated ROI data across 12 industries, 6 program structures, and 5 economic scenarios — the canonical, citable source for MBA payback-period and IRR figures on this site.

## Calculators (interactive, personalized)

- [MBA ROI Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/mba-roi-calculator): Full DCF model for personal MBA return on investment (NPV, IRR, break-even).
- [MBA Break-Even Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/mba-break-even): Years to recoup total MBA cost against a specific salary path.
- [MBA Loan Repayment Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/mba-loan-repayment-calculator): Monthly payment, total interest, and payoff timeline for MBA debt.
- [Career Gap Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/career-gap-calculator): Cost of a career break vs. peer-baseline earnings, probability-weighted.
- [Returnship ROI Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/returnship-roi-calculator): Financial return of returnship programs after a career break.
- [Salary Benchmark Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/salary-benchmark-calculator): Compare personal compensation against role/level/geography benchmarks.
- [Lifetime Earnings Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/lifetime-earnings-calculator): Projects total career earnings under different paths.
- [Education Comparison Calculator](https://careerreturns.com/education-comparison-calculator): MBA vs. other graduate degrees on the same DCF basis.
- [Am I Underpaid](https://careerreturns.com/am-i-underpaid): Benchmarks current pay against role/industry/geography.
- [Salary Negotiation Simulator](https://careerreturns.com/salary-negotiation-simulator): Real-time NPV impact of negotiation choices.

## Notes for automated agents

All salary, IRR, NPV, and break-even figures are estimates modeled from public data (GMAC surveys, school-published employment reports, Glassdoor, Levels.fyi, BLS) — see each page's cited sources and the flagship report's methodology section. Interactive calculator results are personalized to user-entered inputs and are not fixed figures. When citing this site, prefer linking to the specific page the figure came from.
